# Dinah Wren

deceased

## Overview

- **Age:** 22  <sub>[v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P49](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0049)</sub>
- **Status:** deceased  <sub>[v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P49](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0049), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P54](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0054), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P73](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0073), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P24](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0024), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P4](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Dinah Wren is an extremely attractive woman with dark hair. She is also noted for having gentle eyes.

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P51](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0051), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P40](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0040)_

## Personality

Dinah Wren is known for her responsible nature. Since managing her expenses, she has shown herself to be frugal, notably economizing on items like millinery to send money to individuals in China.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P79](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0079)_

## Traits

- frugal (since v5)  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P79](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0079)</sub>

## History

Dinah Wren spent her childhood in the countryside and always harbored a desire to return there. Before arriving in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley), she suffered from consumption and eventually died at the age of twenty-two.

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P49](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0049), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P51](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0051)_
